shortDescription:
Mr. Amit Gupta holds a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) and is an accomplished IT professional with over 17 years of experience in Information Technology, SAP, Enterprise Applications and Digital Transformation. He has worked with leading organizations including UFlex, Kaane Packaging, Paharpur 3P and KG Flexx, managing technology initiatives across manufacturing and business environments.

Mr. Gupta focuses on aligning technology with business objectives, improving operational efficiency and enabling scalable digital solutions. His leadership experience covers IT strategy, project and programme management, vendor management, cybersecurity and digital transformation, with a strong emphasis on business value, governance and sustainable technology growth.
biography: Currently serving as the Head – Information Technology at Product Armor, Amit is responsible for driving the organization's digital transformation roadmap, strengthening IT governance, enhancing cybersecurity, modernizing enterprise infrastructure, and delivering innovative technology solutions that improve business performance. He works closely with leadership teams to ensure technology acts as a strategic business enabler rather than just a support function.

shortDescription:
17+ years of experience in Quality Operations with Proven skills to upgrade Total Quality Management Systems with continual improvements, strategic planning and execution. Develop robust Controls using Lean Six Sigma Concepts to improve overall productivity with Quality and customer Satisfaction.

Certified Six Sigma Black Belt.

Certified ISO QMS 9001, cGMP 15378, EMS 14001 and OH&S 45001, 50001, EnMS systems Auditor.
Exposure of handling all Quality Control & Quality Assurance development activities, Continual Improvement projects.

A results-driven Supply Chain Management professional with 20 years of extensive experience in managing and optimizing end-to-end supply chain operations across leading organizations including Madura Coats, Welspun India, Skanem India , EPL Limited, and Amcor Flexibles.

Manickam holds a B.Tech in Chemical Engineering and an MBA in Operations Management, combining strong technical knowledge with business and operational expertise. Over the course of his career, he has  developed comprehensive experience across the entire supply chain value chain, with a strong focus on operational excellence, cost optimization, service improvement, inventory efficiency, and strategic supply chain management.

His expertise spans Production Planning, Demand Planning, Procurement, Inventory Management, Warehouse Management, Logistics, Supplier & Vendor Management, Supply Chain Strategy and Optimization, Contract negotiation, Pricing and Service Level Agreements and Process Improvement.  He has worked extensively on aligning supply chain operations with business requirements, improving supply chain visibility, optimizing working capital, and ensuring timely and efficient movement of materials and finished goods

Abhishek Mishra brings over 17 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing and operations leadership, with expertise in operational excellence, manufacturing efficiency, process optimization, regulatory compliance, and greenfield projects.

He has led large-scale manufacturing operations and cross-functional teams across reputed pharmaceutical organizations, including Elys Pharmaceutical Industries, Zydus Cadila, Cipla, Ipca Laboratories, Aurobindo Pharma, Ranbaxy Laboratories, and Indoco Remedies.

At Product Armor, Abhishek leads Plant Operations, driving manufacturing excellence, productivity, automation, and continuous improvement across the organization. His experience includes working with global regulatory standards such as USFDA, MHRA, EU-GMP, TGA, PMDA, Health Canada, and WHO.

Manish Tandon is an accomplished business leader with over 27 years of experience across Sales, Marketing, General Management, business transformation, and P&L leadership. As Chief Executive Officer, he brings strong expertise in building businesses, driving market expansion, strengthening customer relationships, and leading high-performing teams across diverse sectors. 

He has held leadership roles with reputed organizations including UFlex, Johnson & Johnson, Tetra Pak, Channelplay, Procter & Gamble, and Cadbury. Manish is known for his strategic clarity, disciplined execution, and commitment to sustainable growth. His leadership approach is focused on accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and long-term value creation for customers, partners, employees, and stakeholders.

Deepika Vijaykumar leads the organization's people strategy while overseeing Administration, Security, and Facility operations. With over a decade of experience across pharmaceutical manufacturing, healthcare, and SaaS health-tech, she has built and transformed HR functions, partnered closely with business leaders to drive organizational growth, and established scalable people practices that strengthen culture, leadership, and performance. Passionate about building high-performing organizations, Deepika combines strategic thinking with operational excellence to create workplaces where people and businesses grow together.

Mr. Harsha Chigurupat is the Founder and Director of Product Armor Packaging Pvt Ltd. Under his leadership, the organisation has transformed itself into India 10th Top Bottle, Container, Caps and closure manufacturing Companies

he has focused on driving transformation, innovation, and long-term strategic growth across the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors. With leadership responsibilities spanning technology, transformation, and organizational development, He is particularly passionate about leveraging emerging technologies, artificial intelligence, and advanced manufacturing to create scalable, globally competitive businesses. Combining an entrepreneurial mindset with a strong emphasis on accountability, agility, and execution, he continues to champion initiatives that strengthen organizational capabilities, foster innovation, and position the company for sustained global growth.
